items_flat.title_en: Musk: Grok 4.7 ≈ Opus 5.0; 4.8 finishes training this week; 4.9 ‘Astra/Fable class’
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克：Grok 4.7 約當 Opus 5.0；4.8 本週完成訓練；4.9 對標 Astra/Fable
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk said Grok 4.7 ‘should be roughly on par with Opus 5.0, not 5.1,’ with multimodal performance still to fix, and that Grok 4.8 will be a noticeable improvement. He separately said Grok 4.8 is a 2.5T model trained on a new C++ stack that ‘will finish training this week and start RL,’ called Grok 4.9 ‘probably Astra/Fable class,’ and left Grok 5 as ‘maybe better than anything.’ No official xAI model page or API identifier for 4.7/4.8 appeared.
items_flat.summary_zh: 馬斯克表示 Grok 4.7「大致與 Opus 5.0 相當、而非 5.1」，多模態仍需修好；4.8 會有明顯提升。他另稱 4.8 是以新 C++ 堆疊訓練的 2.5T 模型，「本週完成訓練並開始 RL」，4.9「大概是 Astra/Fable 級」，Grok 5 則「也許比任何東西都強」。xAI 官方模型頁與 API 仍未出現 4.7／4.8 識別碼。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an executive roadmap, not a ship. The gap between Musk’s dates and a named API/model card remains the uncertainty; treating 4.7 as released would be incorrect until xAI posts identifiers and availability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是執行長路線圖，不是上市。在 xAI 放出模型識別碼與可用範圍前，不應把 4.7 當成已發布；日期與官方產品頁之間的落差仍是關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.7 should be roughly on par with Opus 5.0, not 5.1. Better in some ways, worse in others. We need to fix multimodal performance. Grok 4.8 will be a noticeable improvement. Grok 4.9 is probably Astra/Fable class. Grok 5 maybe better than anything.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.7 應大致與 Opus 5.0 相當，而非 5.1。有些地方更好、有些更差。我們需要修好多模態。Grok 4.8 會有明顯進步。Grok 4.9 大概是 Astra/Fable 級。Grok 5 也許比任何東西都強。

items_flat.title_en: Altman: pacing is not stopping; OpenAI writes safety cases before frontier RL runs
items_flat.title_zh: Altman：放慢不是停擺；OpenAI 在前沿強化學習前先寫安全論證
items_flat.summary_en: Sam Altman said frontier labs should provide confidence they will act responsibly without waiting for an antitrust exemption, and that OpenAI now writes explicit safety cases before frontier RL runs expected to raise capability. He defined ‘pacing’ as slower than the maximum possible pace, not a halt, and warned against both loss of control to AI and excessive concentration of power in one lab or country. OpenAI’s news page listed no matching product or model post in this window.
items_flat.summary_zh: Sam Altman 表示前沿實驗室不應等到反壟斷豁免才證明會負責任行事，並稱 OpenAI 現在會在預期大幅提升能力的前沿強化學習前撰寫明確安全論證。他將「pacing」定義為慢於最大可能速度、而非停擺，並同時警告失控與權力過度集中於單一實驗室或國家。OpenAI 新聞頁在此窗口沒有對應產品或模型文。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a policy stance from the CEO, not a shipped control or third-party audit. Whether other labs adopt comparable pre-RL safety cases is still unstated.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是執行長政策表態，不是已上線的控制項或第三方稽核。其他實驗室會否採用類似的預訓練安全論證，目前仍無官方承諾。
items_flat.quote: When we talk about “pacing”, we do not mean “stopping”. Progress has been rapid and will continue to be. But it should be slower than it otherwise could be; interventions like safety cases and monitoring have significant costs.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們說的「放慢節奏」不是「停下來」。進展一直很快、也會繼續快。但它應該比原本能達到的速度更慢；安全論證與監控這類干預成本很高。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Bot can now route VM egress through the user’s local machine
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Bot 可把虛擬機出口流量改走使用者本機 IP
items_flat.summary_en: Musk confirmed that Grok Bot can route the agent VM’s outbound connections through the user’s local machine instead of a datacenter IP. The setting is described as Settings > Computer > Route egress, intended for sites that block datacenter ranges or require the user’s own IP.
items_flat.summary_zh: 馬斯克確認 Grok Bot 可把代理虛擬機的對外連線改經使用者本機，而非資料中心 IP。設定路徑為 Settings > Computer > Route egress，用於擋資料中心網段或必須本機 IP 的服務。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a networking control for persistent agents, not a new model. It reduces a common blocker for logged-in sites, while shifting more of the trust boundary onto the user’s home or office network.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是長駐代理的網路控制，不是新模型。它降低登入型網站常見阻擋，但也把更多信任邊界移到使用者家用或辦公室網路。
items_flat.quote: Grok Bot now lets your route through your local machine
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現在可以讓你改走本機路由。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA: Perplexity Portable Computer lands on Windows RTX PCs (24GB+ VRAM)
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA：Perplexity Portable Computer 登陸 Windows RTX 電腦（需 24GB+ 顯示記憶體）
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA and Perplexity said Portable Computer is now in the Perplexity Windows app on GeForce RTX and RTX PRO GPUs with 24GB or more VRAM. The local agent runs harness, agents and a post-trained Qwen 3.8 27B on-device so completed local work does not consume cloud credits, and asks permission before escalating to frontier cloud models. DGX Station support is listed as coming soon.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 與 Perplexity 宣布 Portable Computer 已進入 Windows 版 Perplexity 應用，支援 24GB 以上顯示記憶體的 GeForce RTX 與 RTX PRO。本機代理可在裝置上跑編排、代理與經後訓練的 Qwen 3.8 27B，本機完成的工作不消耗雲端額度，升級到前沿雲端模型前需取得同意。DGX Station 支援標為即將推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: The story is local-agent distribution, not a new NVIDIA foundation model. Hardware floor (24GB VRAM) still limits who can actually run the stack privately.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 重點是本機代理通路，不是 NVIDIA 新基礎模型。24GB 顯示記憶體門檻仍限制真正能離線跑完整堆疊的使用者範圍。
items_flat.quote: Together with @Perplexity_AI, we’re making local AI more private, accessible and useful on @Windows NVIDIA RTX PCs.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們與 Perplexity 合作，讓本機 AI 在搭載 NVIDIA RTX 的 Windows PC 上更私密、更容易取得、也更實用。

items_flat.title_en: Google AI highlights Dreambeans: opt-in daily stories from Gmail, Calendar, Photos, Gemini
items_flat.title_zh: Google AI 宣傳 Dreambeans：可選用 Gmail、日曆、相簿與 Gemini 生成每日故事
items_flat.summary_en: @GoogleAI described Dreambeans from Google Labs as an opt-in experience that connects Gmail, Calendar, Search, Gemini and Photos face grouping to generate a finite daily set of illustrated stories and next-step links. The post stresses privacy filters and a thumbs-down control. The underlying U.S. expansion post on Google’s blog is dated September 10; today’s item is an official product recap, not a new model.
items_flat.summary_zh: @GoogleAI 介紹 Google Labs 的 Dreambeans：在使用者同意下串連 Gmail、日曆、Search、Gemini 與相簿人臉分組，每天產出有限則數的插畫故事與下一步連結，並強調隱私過濾與倒讚回饋。美國全面開放的部落格原文日期為 9 月 10 日；今日為官方產品再說明，不是新模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: Signal is product distribution and personal-context use, not a Gemini version bump. How aggressively Photos face grouping is used, and outside the U.S., remains bounded by the earlier Labs post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 訊號是產品通路與個人脈絡應用，不是 Gemini 版本升級。相簿人臉分組用到多深、以及美國以外進度，仍以稍早 Labs 公告為準。
items_flat.quote: This experience is opt-in, transparent, and protected by strict privacy filters. And because you are always in control, you can simply tap the "thumbs down" button on any story if a suggestion misses the mark.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此體驗採選擇加入、流程透明，並受嚴格隱私過濾保護。你始終保有控制權，任何故事不合用只要點倒讚，系統就會學習什麼對你真正有用。
